Hydraulic Control Quadrant
(See Fig. 81)

      The hydraulic control levers are held in
position by spring-loaded friction washers,
which, after considerable usage, may be-
come worn and allow the levers to "creep"
from their desired setting. To compensate
for wear, tighten the machine screw on each
lever, which secures the friction washer un-
til the desired tension is obtained.
